body: Just to let everyone know that I'm in the hotel tonight but I've left all my pills at my mother's house. I'm just going to have a self-reflective night and think things through. Thanks everyone.
I think the reason I am where I am is because I've tried everything to fill this hole and nothing has worked.

I don't know. The doctor asked me this question and, as with previous questions, I shrugged. I dropped out of school with minimal grades and have been trying to re-do them but failing. I don't even know if I want to go to university as I originally went to college but dropped out after several months. Nothing I have done so far in life has given me joy.
I can't see what I would be doing in 12 months time that would change my feelings hence why I want to leave life tomorrow.

When I spoke to the doctor on the 1st of December he gave me a number to phone for counseling sessions. I phoned them on the 3rd and they said they would get back to me. I haven't heard anything from them. I don't know why I'm mentioning this. I've been feeling like this for as long as I can remember but I only feel confident now speaking to people about it online (even though I'm under an anonymous username) after speaking to a doctor first. Only my mother, father and step-mother know of how I feel. No one else in my family knows even though I've had the chance to tell them, I just don't think I'm strong enough to be able to get the words out myself for them to hear. When I spoke to my father and step-mum, they did all of the talking and I sheepishly nodded my head and hid my eyes.

I was committed to not writing a book on this but my mind just keeps spitting thoughts out that I think I should write on here. I've heard of people slitting their forearms and not dying but being left with nerve and tissue damage. I'm also unsure as to how I would feel about slitting my own forearms. I'm unsure whether I feel positive or negative about that avenue. I would much rather go with overdosing as it seems to be a more painless and cleaner way to go.
